maxLength.description: Longest message: Longer messages are cut.

fadeSeconds.description: Stays on screen: Seconds the messages stay visible after a new one while the chat is closed.

history.description: Messages kept: How many messages each player keeps to scroll back.

showJoins.description: Join and leave messages: Tells everyone when a player joins or leaves.

noSlash.description: Commands without /: The input opens in Command mode: players type a command without the slash. Tab moves through Command and the channels; a line starting with / still runs as a command in any channel.
